title: A tier with a different value per range is saved as one bullet per range
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, two ranges ($0.00 to $25.00 and $25.01 and up), pricing one new category made for this test, tier A on Margin % 30 in both ranges.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type 35 in tier A's first range.
  5. Type 28 in tier A's last range.
  6. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens in view.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit, with Cancel and Save.

Step 4:

  • Tier A's first range reads 35.

Step 5:

  • Tier A's last range reads 28.

Step 6:

  • A message reads matrix A's name followed by "saved", with "Parts already on work orders keep their prices."
  • In it, tier A's change reads tier A's name followed by "is", then one bullet per range.
  • The first bullet reads "$0.00 to $25.00: 35% margin" and the second names the last range with 28% margin.
  • The grid returns to view.
